title: Console: add RiskBadge component + tooltips for risk explanations
author: Nora Ahmed
description: Summary: Introduces a shared RiskBadge UI component (Low/Medium/High) plus standardized tooltips and an explanation renderer used by the Optimization Suggestions details drawer. Motivation: The Suggestions beta needs consistent, accessible risk labeling (performance/reliability risk) across list rows, filter chips, and the details drawer; we also want the copy/structure to be centrally maintained so we can iterate without chasing multiple one-off implementations. Scope: UI-only; no API changes. Implements (1) <RiskBadge /> with severity mapping (color + icon + text), (2) <RiskTooltip /> content wrapper with consistent disclaimer language, and (3) <ExplanationBlock /> for rendering “Why this is risky” sections with guardrails + assumption bullets. Notes: Tooltips use our existing Popover primitives and are keyboard navigable; badges never rely on color alone (always include label text). Colors come from design tokens and were checked against WCAG contrast requirements on both light/dark themes. Out of scope: risk scoring logic/thresholds, estimate math, any changes to telemetry or backend fields. Testing: added component tests for rendering/aria-labels, plus Storybook stories for each variant. Rollout: no flag required; component is unused until wired by PR-21957, but safe to land early. Screenshots: Storybook snapshots linked below (RiskBadge/Low, RiskBadge/Medium, RiskBadge/High; Tooltip open states).
commits: ui(console): add RiskBadge component + severity tokens
ui(console): add RiskTooltip wrapper + standardized copy blocks
ui(console): add ExplanationBlock for risk/assumptions sections
tests(storybook): add stories for risk badge + tooltip states
a11y: add aria-labels + focus management for tooltip trigger
review_conversation: Tessa Morgan (requested changes): Badge colors look good, but Medium contrast seems borderline in dark mode. Also please avoid the word “danger” in tooltip copy; use “risk” consistently and clarify it’s performance/reliability risk (not security). Nora Ahmed (author): Updated tokens for Medium in dark mode and reran contrast checks; removed “danger” wording and aligned tooltip copy with the latest DES-640 draft (“Risk indicates likelihood of latency/SLO impact”). Kenji Nakamura (comment): Can we ensure the badge reads correctly in table density modes? The icon seems to compress in dense rows. Nora Ahmed: Adjusted min-width + line-height; added a dense-mode story. Dylan Brooks (comment): Please keep the prop surface minimal; we’ll use this in multiple screens. Prefer enum + optional ‘explanation’ slot rather than letting callers pass arbitrary JSX. Nora Ahmed: Refactored to RiskLevel type ('low'|'medium'|'high') and constrained variants; ExplanationBlock is the only freeform area and is intentionally structured (title + bullets). Allison Grant (comment): Tooltips need deterministic aria attributes for our automated a11y checks. Also please ensure the trigger is reachable via keyboard and tooltip content is announced. Nora Ahmed: Added aria-describedby wiring, tooltip id generation, and verified with axe; added unit tests asserting role='tooltip' and focus behavior. Tessa Morgan (approval): Approved after contrast + copy updates. Dylan Brooks (approval): LGTM. Kenji Nakamura (approval): Looks good with dense rows.
release_notes: Internal: Adds shared RiskBadge + tooltip/explanation components for Optimization Suggestions risk labeling in Console (no user-visible change until Suggestions view is enabled).
